messages:
michael: Seeing repeated ECC correctable->uncorrectable flips on gpu-node-7a12 in eu-west-1. A few pods hit OOMs and kube restarted the runtime. Starting a drain now, tagging for hardware replacement. @amy @jamie
amy: Ack. Any indication PSUs/thermal? Also how much traffic are we losing?
infra-bot: ALERT: node gpu-node-7a12 | ECC_UNCORRECTABLE x6 in 10m | kernel: gpu fault -> dmesg attached to node logs | pod restarts 4 -> fired at 1769004315
chris: Run drain and cordon. Command: `kubectl drain gpu-node-7a12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data && kubectl cordon gpu-node-7a12`
michael: Ran drain, some pods evicted. Output:
```
Evicting pod frontend-ml-12
Evicting pod batch-train-7
Node gpu-node-7a12 cordoned
```
irene: Can we shift traffic to us-west1 as a short-term fallback? eu-west SLAs are degrading on p99 latency. We should do a weighted shift, not full cutover.
jamie: Oncall here. Kicking off canary shift now: setting routing weights `eu-west:80 -> us-west1:20` for inference routes. Will watch p50/p95.
amy: Opening vendor ticket now. Suspect PSU + memory channel. Vendor case #VND-2026-0421. RMA requested, ETA replacement part 48-72h.
chris: Also seeing nvme SMART errors in the same rack (rack-eu3-05). Dumped smartctl: `Reallocated_Sector_Ct: 124, Current_Pending_Sector: 8`. Suspect broader hardware degradation on that rack — let's avoid scheduling critical batch on racks eu3-05 and eu3-06.
michael: Capacity shortfall: Dedicated pool has 2 spare GPUs but they're pinned to internal test. Requesting permission to burst them for 12h to cover peak. Cost impact small vs customer latency.
ajamie: (typo corrected) jamie: I moved two spare Dedicated GPUs into the routing pool for 6h. Commands run: `redwood infra allocate --pool dedicated-eu3 --count 2 --duration 6h` — confirmed in console. :white_check_mark:
amy: Vendor asked for sysinfo and logs; provided serial GPU SN00087 and node asset tag. Planned swap window tomorrow 0200-0400 UTC. Will post PR for maintenance.
chris: Marking nodes `rack-eu3-05-*` as `NO_SCHEDULE` in cluster to avoid further evictions: `kubectl label node rack-eu3-05-1 avoid-schedule=true`. Also flagged in inventory.
infra-bot: ROUTE UPDATE: traffic weights changed (eu-west:80 -> us-west1:20). Autoscaler paused for affected auto-pools.
irene: Setting temporary alert: p99 latency > 350ms -> paging. Also adding token-cost spike alert for cross-region egress.
michael: Evicted low-priority batch jobs. We should keep an eye on KV cache warmup in us-west1; initial tail latency might spike.
jamie: Watching metrics. p50 steady, p95 climbing from 220ms->360ms on some routes. If p95 > 400ms after 20m, we'll increase fallback to 40%.
amy: Updated vendor case with logs and requested onsite swap if hardware swap fails. I'll coordinate with ops for access.
chris: Filed infra ticket INFRA-8763 to track replacement, rack inspection, and post-mortem. Linking to this thread.
michael: Thanks. After replacement we should run full memory burn and run KV cache integrity checks before reschedule.
jamie: Noted. I'll update the incident board and keep the canary ramp plan in the ticket. :eyes:
amy: Vendor ETA confirmed 2026-03-20 03:30 UTC for swap. Scheduling maintenance.
deploy-bot: Deploy job #5421 paused due to node drain on gpu-node-7a12.
chris: OK folks — keep pings here. If anyone sees a new ECC spike, post kernel dump ASAP. :thumbsup:
